디모데전서 2:1.content: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

디모데전서 2:2.content: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

디모데전서 2:3.content: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

디모데전서 2:4.content: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

디모데전서 2:5.content: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

디모데전서 2:6.content: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

디모데전서 2:7.content: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

디모데전서 2:8.content: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

디모데전서 2:9.content: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

디모데전서 2:10.content: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

디모데전서 2:11.content: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

디모데전서 2:12.content: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

디모데전서 2:13.content: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

디모데전서 2:14.content: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

디모데전서 2:15.content: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
